2609.27606.title: State-Grounded Conditioning: Wrapping User-Facing LLM Agents Where Direction Depends on Live State
2609.27606.paper_summary: We introduce State-Grounded Conditioning (SGC), a design principle for user-facing LLM agents that must condition on live user state (game state, session history, live inventory), and a distinct failure class we call direction drift: task-complete responses whose chosen direction misaligns with the current state. SGC externalises state-dependent control into rule kernels over structured inputs and three primary state slices, via Perception, Grounding, and Interaction wrappers with explicit conditioning dependencies. We evaluate SGC on a 200-session anonymised benchmark ($\approx$1,000 assistant model turns) from an in-game conversational coaching agent that guides players through consecutive competitive matches, reporting mean first-token latency and five human-annotated dialogue-quality metrics that jointly cover factual grounding and coach-like guidance progression. The Perception wrapper holds mean first-token latency at 1.5s (vs. 6.1s for PE-Agent inside a production tool-use harness); enabling all three wrappers lifts turn-level grounded accuracy from 61.1%/69.8% (Prompting / PE-Agent) to 96.7% and session-level grounded accuracy from 20.0%/26.5% to 83.5%; session-level grounding-failure incidents drop by $\approx$78% relative to the strongest baseline. A cumulative ablation shows complementary incremental gains as the wrappers are added. These results inform approximate state-slice orthogonality, without establishing independent per-wrapper effects.
2609.27606.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了狀態基礎條件（SGC），這是一種設計原則，適用於必須基於實時用戶狀態（遊戲狀態、會話歷史、實時庫存）進行條件設定的用戶面向大型語言模型代理，並且我們稱之為方向漂移的一種明確失敗類別：任務完成的回應，其選擇的方向與當前狀態不一致。SGC 將狀態依賴的控制外部化為結構化輸入上的規則內核和三個主要狀態切片，通過感知、基礎和互動包裝器，並具有明確的條件依賴性。我們在一個 200 次會話的匿名基準測試上評估 SGC（約 1,000 次助手模型回合），該基準測試來自一個在遊戲中提供對話教練的代理，該代理指導玩家進行連續的競技比賽，報告平均首個標記延遲和五個由人類標註的對話質量指標，這些指標共同涵蓋事實基礎和教練式指導進展。感知包裝器將平均首個標記延遲保持在 1.5 秒（相比之下，PE-Agent 在生產工具使用框架內為 6.1 秒）；啟用所有三個包裝器將回合級的基礎準確率從 61.1%/69.8%（提示 / PE-Agent）提升至 96.7%，會話級的基礎準確率從 20.0%/26.5% 提升至 83.5%；會話級的基礎失敗事件相對於最強基準下降約 78%。累積的消融顯示出隨著包裝器的添加而產生的互補增益。這些結果提供了有關近似狀態切片正交性的資訊，但並未建立每個包裝器的獨立效應。
